scene: Crawl out the duct onto a bustling junction platform under glowing signs.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a multi-level transit deck. On the far left sits a waiting night tram labelled Photo Bazaar. Left of centre, the boy in the denim jacket, clutching his camera and humming fuse, steps off a duct grate. Right of centre stands an open service elevator. On the far right, a wooden rowing boat bobs at a canal edge.
